description: This file provides API helper functions for restaurant management and order handling in a food delivery frontend, aligned with backend OpenAPI specifications. It includes functions to list, create, update, and delete restaurants, menus, menu items, and orders. The functions utilize a shared `apiFetch` utility for HTTP requests and are annotated as public interfaces.

methods.name: listRestaurantsApi({ include_inactive = false, limit = 100, offset = 0 } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Lists restaurants with optional filters for inactive status, limit, and offset.

methods.name: getRestaurantApi(restaurantId, getToken)
methods.description: Retrieves details of a single restaurant by its ID.

methods.name: listMenusByRestaurantApi(restaurantId, { include_inactive = true } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Lists menus for a specific restaurant, with an option to include inactive menus.

methods.name: createMenuApi(restaurantId, { name, description = null, is_active = true }, getToken)
methods.description: Creates a new menu under a specified restaurant.

methods.name: updateMenuApi( restaurantId, menuId, { name = null, description = null, is_active = null } = {}, getToken )
methods.description: Updates a menu's details, with optional fields.

methods.name: listMenuItemsApi( restaurantId, menuId, { include_unavailable = true } = {}, getToken )
methods.description: Lists items on a specific menu, with an option to include unavailable items.

methods.name: createMenuItemApi( restaurantId, menuId, { name, description = null, price_cents, currency = "USD", image_url = null, is_available = true }, getToken )
methods.description: Creates a menu item under a specific menu, requiring details like name, price, and availability.

methods.name: updateMenuItemApi( restaurantId, menuId, itemId, { name = null, description = null, price_cents = null, currency = null, image_url = null, is_available = null } = {}, getToken )
methods.description: Updates a menu item with optional fields.

methods.name: listMyOrdersApi({ status_filter = null } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Lists orders visible to the current user, filtered by status if provided.

methods.name: getOrderApi(orderId, getToken)
methods.description: Fetches details of an order by ID.

methods.name: updateOrderStatusApi(orderId, status, getToken)
methods.description: Transitions an order to a new status.
